texts.introduction: kv.digital is a digital agency specializing in web development and design.
texts.role: Lead Frontend Developer responsible for developing and maintaining the company website.
texts.technologies: Utilized Angular for frontend development, Figma for design collaboration, Storybook for UI component development, SonarQube for code quality analysis, and Jenkins for continuous integration and deployment.
texts.challenges: Ensured cross-browser compatibility and optimized performance for a seamless user experience.
texts.takeaways: Gained experience in leading a development team and implementing best practices in web development.
